Tune in as 9to5Mac brings you the day's top Apple news stories in summary form. 9to5Mac Daily is available on iTunes, the Apple Podcasts app, Stitcher, TuneIn, Google Play, or via our dedicated RSS feed in Overcast and other podcast players.

This episode is sponsored by Stuff: Stuff helps you clear all the noise from your head and organize it into a simple, elegant system — ending loose ends and relieving mental pressure. An easy-to-use to-do list for iPhone, iPad, and Mac, packed with powerful tools that make organizing, tracking, and checking off your tasks more satisfying. Let Stuff help you get things done.

9to5Mac Daily records a new episode every weekday. Make sure to subscribe to our show on Apple Podcasts or your favorite podcast player so new episodes are delivered as soon as they go live.

Stories covered in this episode:

  • Apple releases iOS 27.0.1 for iPhone, here's what's new
  • Leak reveals unannounced new feature coming to iPhone Duo
  • iOS 27 brings three key new features to Find My
  • Apple releases macOS 27.0.1, macOS 26.7.1, and macOS 15.8.1
